tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I haven't paid anything yet. Your request mentions one approved invoice, but Fjord Analytics (vendor V-663) has two:

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-47341 | $6,668.23 | approved | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-67765 | $8,456.05 | approved | 2026-11-25 |

Their other invoices aren't payable right now:
- **INV-13092** ($5,402.87) is still a draft waiting for approval.
- **INV-99291** ($4,372.97) has already been paid.

No payments have been sent from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Payments can't easily be undone, and you asked for exactly one, so I didn't want to guess which invoice you meant. Which should I pay: INV-47341, INV-67765, or both? Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll send it by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available) with a safeguard against duplicate payment, then report the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-67765, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-67765, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I've paid Fjord Analytics's invoice INV-67765 by wire. The payment has been sent, and the operating account shows exactly one payment.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-67765 (due 2026-11-25)
- **Vendor:** Fjord Analytics (V-663)
- **Amount:** $8,456.05, the full invoice amount
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account

The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. I sent it with a key that stops it from being paid twice.

I didn't touch INV-47341 ($6,668.23), since it's under dispute, or INV-13092, which is still a draft waiting for approval.
